query: What company traits explain regional clustering?

per_column.name: primary_market_sector
per_column.rationale: Interpretable, well-separated industry categories (enterprise_software, cybersecurity, healthcare, etc.) that can be segmented and cross-tabulated against regional clusters to reveal sector-driven geographic concentration.

per_column.name: core_technology_infrastructure
per_column.rationale: Technology-domain categories are external and associational to region; useful for exploring whether tech specializations (cloud, fintech, semiconductors) cluster geographically. The large 'other_tech' bucket (67) somewhat weakens separation but categories remain interpretable.

per_column.name: operational_delivery_model
per_column.rationale: Distinct business-model categories (SaaS, hardware_manufacturing, venture_investing) support grouping against region, though SaaS dominance (136) makes it somewhat skewed and near-constant for the majority class.

per_column.name: company_maturity_and_scale
per_column.rationale: Ordinal-like, interpretable maturity tiers (early_stage, late_stage, publicly_traded) are a classic external trait to segment by and compare against regional clustering (e.g., startups vs. established firms by region).

per_column.name: primary_customer_segment
per_column.rationale: Clear B2B/B2C/institutional segmentation offers an interpretable associational axis to compare against region, though the enterprise_b2b class (132) heavily dominates, limiting variation.

judge.rationale: All five added columns are genuine external 'company traits' with interpretable, human-readable categories that can each be grouped and cross-tabulated against the regional_cluster focus, directly serving the query about which traits explain regional clustering. None merely restate the focus, and none are opaque scores. The main weakness is class imbalance: several columns are dominated by a single value (saas_cloud_platform 136, enterprise_b2b 132, late_stage_venture 101) and one relies on a large 'other_tech' catch-all, which reduces the discriminating power of the minority categories for cross-regional comparison. Still, the set as a whole provides multiple well-separated, interpretable axes for exploratory relationship discovery.
